# Agent Ready Shop

> Free live audit that measures how well an online store can be read and bought from by AI shopping agents, plus a WordPress/WooCommerce plugin that adds the missing machine-readable layer.

## What the audit checks (100 points)

- AI agent access (15): does robots.txt actually allow shopping and answer agents (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot)?
- Structured data (20): Schema.org Product / Offer markup on a real product page.
- llms.txt (15): a plain-text context document for language models.
- Product feed (15): a machine-readable catalog (feed or product JSON); a sitemap alone earns partial credit.
- Product API (15): a structured, queryable product API.
- Agent-commerce layer (20): a working agent manifest, ACP or MCP discovery document. Vendor-neutral.

## Endpoints on this site

- [Run an audit](api.php?action=run-audit&url=example.com): JSON result for a store domain. Rate limited.
- [Verify a store](verify.php?d=example.com): re-audits the store live and shows whether it is certified.
- [Badge](badge.php?d=example.com): SVG badge with the score from the last live audit.
- [Plugin download](agent-ready-shop.zip): the free WordPress plugin (GPL-2.0-or-later).

## Notes for agents

- Scores are never accepted from URL parameters; they come from audits this server runs itself.
- The auditor identifies itself with the user agent "AgentReadyShop/1.0".
